subject: Make @zonoid/core bin/install.js a self-sufficient end-to-end installer
description:
PROBLEM: @zonoid/core's bin/install.js (the `zonoid-install` bin, the only installer shipped in the vendored core tarball) is just a config-wirer — it writes .mcp.json + .claude/settings.json and nothing else. The full end-to-end installer lives in a SEPARATE package, @zonoid/cli (packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js, `npx @zonoid/cli init`), which @zonoid/core's package.json `files` list EXCLUDES (no `packages/`). So a repo that vendors @zonoid/core (e.g. HY_world) can never reach the end-to-end experience: skills, pre-push guard, CLAUDE.md, and workspace registration are never installed.

GOAL (user-approved "option 1"): fold these FOUR capabilities from packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js into bin/install.js so the core package installs end-to-end on its own, preserving the single-tarball model:
  1. SKILLS — symlink every dir under <INSTALL_DIR>/skills into ~/.claude/skills. Port the linkSkill() symlink→junction→copy fallback (zonoid.js:419) and checkSkills() idempotency/repair logic (zonoid.js:441). MUST be cross-platform (Windows junction fallback without elevation).
  2. PRE-PUSH TEST GUARD — port prePushTestCommand() (zonoid.js:767), prePushTestHookScript() (zonoid.js:782), checkPrePushTestHook() (zonoid.js:792). Resolve hooks dir via `git rev-parse --git-path hooks`; do NOT overwrite a foreign pre-push hook.
  3. CLAUDE.md MERGE — port renderClaudeInstructions() (zonoid.js:53) + checkClaude() (zonoid.js:388): append the orchestrator section to <workspace>/CLAUDE.md only if not already present; rewrite localhost dashboard URLs to this workspace.
  4. WORKSPACE REGISTRATION — port registerWorkspace() (zonoid.js:554): best-effort POST /workspace to the daemon (resolve repo root via lib/workspace-registry.js); never fail the install if the daemon is down.

CONSTRAINTS:
  - Keep ALL existing behavior (the two JSON writers) and the existing flags (--dry-run, --user, --workspace, --install-dir, --port). In --dry-run mode the new steps must print what they WOULD do and write nothing (skills/CLAUDE.md/pre-push/registration all no-op under DRY).
  - Idempotent + re-runnable (same as today). Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) — forward-slash paths, junction fallback, chmod wrapped in try/catch.
  - REFACTOR for testability: export the functions (linkSkill, checkSkills, prePushTestCommand, prePushTestHookScript, checkPrePushTestHook, renderClaudeInstructions, etc.) and guard the script body with `if (require.main === module)`, mirroring how packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js does it. Do NOT change the existing exported-or-not contract for the JSON writers beyond what's needed.
  - ADD test/install.test.js (dependency-free, matches scripts/run-tests.js discovery + the assertion style in test/cli-init.test.js): cover linkSkill fallback branches via injectable stubs, prePushTestCommand (test:all vs test vs none), pre-push foreign-hook non-overwrite, CLAUDE.md idempotent append, and --dry-run writing nothing new.
  - Run `node scripts/run-tests.js` and confirm green before completing.
  - Prefer factoring shared helpers rather than copy-paste drift where clean, but do NOT refactor packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js in this task (out of scope) — porting/duplicating the proven logic into bin/install.js is acceptable.

Reference implementation to port from: packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js. Target file: bin/install.js. New test: test/install.test.js.
